001: Good morning! I spoke with you yesterday about the proposal. Did you have time to review it?
Good morning! Yes, we reviewed it. We really liked the structure, but we have a few questions.
Of course, go ahead. I'm here precisely to clarify any point.
The first question is about the implementation timeline. Can you deliver in two months?
Two months is a tight deadline, but I believe we can do it. I'll confirm with the team.
Perfect. If you can, I think we'll close the contract this week.
002: I received your email about the delivery delay. Can you explain what happened?
Unfortunately, we had a problem with an external supplier. The part arrived defective.
I understand. But this is already going to impact our entire project schedule.
Yes, I know. We're already looking for an alternative supplier to minimize the delay.
Alright. Please keep me informed about any updates.
Will do. I'll send you an update tomorrow morning, without fail.
003: Would you like to add any more clauses to the contract before signing?
Yes, I'd like to include a penalty for late delivery of the monthly reports.
No problem. I can adjust that right now and send you the new version.
Great. And I'd also like to make it clear that the meetings will be biweekly.
Perfect, I'll note that down as well. Anything else?
No, that's it. As soon as I receive the updated version, I'll sign right away.
004: I noticed that the last batch came with some damaged units. Have you identified the cause?
Yes, it was a shipping problem. The packaging couldn't withstand the humidity on the route.
That's concerning. We need a permanent solution, not just a temporary fix.
I agree. We're going to change the packaging material and test a new delivery route.
Okay. And what about the damaged batch, how are we going to resolve that?
We'll replace all affected units within ten days, with shipping on us.
005: Were you satisfied with the presentation we gave yesterday to the board?
Yes, it was very good. The board approved the project, but asked for some adjustments to the budget.
That's great news! Can you tell me what adjustments they suggested?
They thought the maintenance cost was a bit high. We need a leaner alternative.
I see. I'll talk to our technical team to find a viable option.
Perfect. If you can reduce it by ten percent, we have a deal.
006: Good afternoon! I'm calling to confirm whether you received the revised proposal.
Good afternoon! Yes, I received it, but I haven't had time to read it carefully yet.
No rush. I just wanted to know if you had any questions about the figures presented.
Actually, I did have a question about the payment terms. Could you explain again?
Of course. The payment is divided into three installments: half at signing and the rest in two stages.
I see. That's very clear now. I'll review it and give you an answer by Friday.
007: We need to postpone tomorrow's meeting. The director is going on a trip at the last minute.
No problem. Can we reschedule for Thursday, at the same time?
Thursday works. But could you send the main points by email in advance?
Sure, I'll send a summary today with the topics we're going to discuss.
Thank you. That way the director will arrive prepared for the meeting.
Perfect. And if any other change comes up, let me know in advance.
008: Did you see the report I sent yesterday about the project's progress?
Yes, I did. The work is good, but I noticed that some deadlines are tight.
Yes, we had some unexpected issues, but we're managing to keep up with the schedule.
That's good. And is your team keeping up with the workload?
They are. We're even working overtime to ensure the quality of the delivery.
I'm relieved to hear that. Keep it up, it's going very well.
009: We received a complaint from a client about our team's service.
That's unfortunate. Can you give me more details about what happened?
The client said they weren't responded to within the agreed timeframe and were dissatisfied.
I understand. I'll talk to the team today to understand what happened.
Please do. And ask them to reinforce their commitment to deadlines.
Will do. I'll also call the client to apologize personally.
010: Would you like to renew the technical support contract for another year?
Yes, I would. But first I need to know if you're going to keep the same price.
We'll keep the price, but with a small adjustment of five percent.
Five percent is acceptable, as long as the response time stays the same.
Don't worry. Priority support will continue with a response within two hours.
Then it's a deal. You can prepare the contract, and I'll sign it this week.
